paragraphs: The University of Dayton is a private Catholic Marianist research university in Dayton, Ohio. Founded in 1850 by the Society of Mary, it is one of three Marianist universities in the United States and the second-largest private university in Ohio. The Carnegie Classification ranks Dayton as R1: Doctoral Universities — Very high research activity, and it is currently ranked 136th among national universities by U.S. News & World Report (2026).

Dayton organizes its academics into five divisions: the College of Arts and Sciences, the School of Business Administration, the School of Education and Health Sciences, the School of Engineering, and the School of Law. The university offers more than 80 undergraduate programs and 50 graduate and doctoral programs across these schools.

The 388-acre campus sits on the banks of the Great Miami River in southwest Ohio, less than two miles from downtown Dayton, with four sections: Historic Campus, Campus West, River Campus, and the Arena Sports Complex. Over 90% of undergraduates live on campus across five residence halls and the famous Student Neighborhood university-owned houses.

The University of Dayton Research Institute (UDRI) has tripled its externally sponsored research over the last decade, and Dayton is ranked the No. 1 Catholic university in the United States for engineering research and development. The university serves approximately 11,378 students (8,192 undergraduate and 3,186 postgraduate) and over 132,000 living alumni worldwide.
paragraphsRu: University of Dayton — частный католический исследовательский университет Marianist в Дейтоне, штат Огайо. Основан в 1850 году Society of Mary, один из трёх Marianist-университетов США и второй по размеру частный университет Огайо. По Carnegie Classification — R1: Doctoral Universities (Very high research activity), 136-е место среди national universities по версии U.S. News & World Report (2026).

Учёба организована в пять подразделений: College of Arts and Sciences, School of Business Administration, School of Education and Health Sciences, School of Engineering и School of Law. Доступно более 80 программ бакалавриата и 50 программ магистратуры/PhD.

Кампус площадью 388 акров расположен на берегу Great Miami River в 2 милях от центра Дейтона, состоит из четырёх частей: Historic Campus, Campus West, River Campus и Arena Sports Complex. Более 90% бакалавров живут на кампусе — в пяти резиденциях и знаменитом Student Neighborhood (университетские дома).

University of Dayton Research Institute (UDRI) утроил объём внешне финансируемых исследований за последнее десятилетие. Dayton — №1 католический университет США по engineering research and development. Около 11 378 студентов (8 192 бакалавриат + 3 186 магистратура) и более 132 000 выпускников по всему миру.
